key_stat: 20M+ UK retail customers | Investment bank £13B income | >14% ROTE target by 2028
summary: Barclays increased profit 12% to £9.1B in 2025 and raised performance targets (>14% ROTE by 2028). Investment bank income £13B (+11%), Global Markets +15%. Strategy: core US/UK focus, AI to cut costs, >£15B capital returns 2026-2028. CEO Venkat: 'moving from measured ambition to accelerating ambition.' Tesco Bank retail acquisition integrated. Plans to double digital transformation investment. GenAI and agile platforms. IT incident (Jan 2025, mainframe failure) cost £5-7.5M in compensation. US consumer bank (cards, Best Egg) growth plans.

business_segments.name: Barclays UK
business_segments.detail: Ring-fenced retail. 20M+ customers. Personal, business banking, Barclaycard UK. 146K mortgage completions (2025). Tesco Bank integration.

business_segments.name: Investment Bank
business_segments.detail: £13B income (+11%). Global Markets (+15% trading). Advisory, underwriting. Top 5 market share. US and UK focus.

business_segments.name: UK Corporate Bank
business_segments.detail: 13K+ businesses. Robust income growth 2025. Connecting group capabilities for clients.

business_segments.name: US Consumer Bank
business_segments.detail: Credit cards (partnerships). Best Egg. Online deposits. Auto lending. Growth target via organic + acquisitions.

business_segments.name: Private Bank & Wealth (PBWM)
business_segments.detail: Growing AUM. Transactional activity strong in 2025. Increasing non-interest income contribution.

technology.ai: GenAI and copilots integrated into unified internal systems. AI for productivity, fraud, credit risk, customer service. 'Embracing GenAI and agile scalable platforms.' Plans to double digital transformation investment.
technology.cloud: Cloud infrastructure modernisation. Agile scalable platforms.
technology.data: Unified data platforms (solving fragmentation with GenAI). Customer analytics. Risk data.
technology.platforms: Mobile banking. Digital business banking. Trading platforms. Open banking.

operating_model: 2025: PBT £9.1B (+12%). New 2028 targets: >14% ROTE, >£15B capital returns. Doubling digital/AI investment. Cost-income ratio target: low 50s by 2028. Investment Bank RWA: mid-50s% → ~50% by 2028. Creating simpler organisation, standardising data and platforms.
risks: Digital assets strategy less developed than peers
competitive_position: Major UK bank + US investment bank. £9.1B PBT (+12%). Investment bank Top 5 target. Competing: JPMorgan/Goldman (IB), Lloyds/NatWest (UK retail), US card issuers. Tesco integration adds retail scale.
